original_title: NP16726 Multi Modality Imaging Equipment and Maintenance Framework
buyer_name: The Common Services Agency (more commonly known as Public Services Delivery Scotland) (PSD Scotland)
english_summary: This is a framework agreement run by PSD Scotland for the supply, installation, maintenance, servicing and repair of diagnostic imaging and therapy equipment across Scotland. It also covers contrast and radiopharmaceutical injectors with their consumables, mammography vacuum devices and lesion/lymph node localisation products, and bladder scanners. Both OEM and third-party (multi-vendor) maintenance are included.
what_they_want: (1) Supply, maintenance, servicing and repair of bladder scanners. (2) Supply, installation and/or maintenance of contrast and radiopharmaceutical injectors, plus syringes and other consumables used with them. (3) OEM and third-party (multi-vendor) maintenance and servicing of diagnostic imaging equipment, including but not limited to X-Ray, Computed Radiography, CT, MR, PET/CT, Mammography, Fluoroscopy, Lithotripter, Interventional, Dental, Bone Densitometry, Image Intensifier, Nuclear Imaging, injectors, specimen cabinets, digital scoliosis systems, Ultrasound, Linear Accelerators and Bladder Scanners. (4) Supply, installation and/or maintenance of mammography vacuum devices and associated consumables, mammography non-wire lesion localisation detectors and devices, sentinel lymph node location detectors, and non-radioactive sentinel lymph node tracer fluids. (5) Supply, installation (including pre-installation works under a turnkey contract with the equipment supplier) and maintenance of diagnostic imaging and therapy equipment, including X-Ray, Computed Radiography, Angiography, Fluoroscopy, Lithotripsy, CT, MR, PET/CT, Mammography, Interventional, Dental, Bone Densitometry, Image Intensifiers, Nuclear Imaging, Linear Accelerators/Linacs, specimen cabinets, scoliosis imaging systems and Ultrasound, as well as mobile units or modular builds where delivered as a turnkey contract with the equipment supplier. No specific brands or model numbers are mentioned.

original_title: NHSDG Estates & Property ICES LOLER Inspection

english_summary: Dumfries and Galloway Health Board is seeking a contractor to carry out LOLER (Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998) inspections of lifting equipment in people's own homes.
